Proof of English Language Proficiency for Graduate Applicants
Applicants whose native language is not English and who received their undergraduate
degrees from non-English speaking institutions must demonstrate a minimum level of
English proficiency to be considered for admission into a University of Toledo Graduate
Program.
The University of Toledo reserves the right to require additional evidence of English
language proficiency for all applicants, the adequacy of which shall be at the sole
discretion of the Graduate Admissions Office.
Demonstrate Proof of English Proficiency
Applicants must demonstrate proof of their English proficiency by meeting at least
one of the following conditions:
English Proficiency Exam
An official English language proficiency test report with at least the minimum scores
listed below:
TOEFL iBT (0-120 scale) 80
TOEFL iBT26 (1-6 scale) 4.0 overall, and 4.0 on all subscores
IELTS Academic 6.5
PTE Academic 58
Duolingo English Test 110
Cambridge English Score 176
Required Documentation
All scores must be submitted through the testing service company directly to the University
of Toledo Graduate Admissions Office. Paper copies or uploaded digital copies are
not acceptable. Test scores must still be valid (not expired) on the first day the
student begins their program.
Educational Background
By the time of enrollment in the desired graduate program, applicant must have successfully
completed a bachelor's, master's or doctoral degree with at least a 2.7 cumulative
GPA on a 4.0 scale from one of the following types of institutions:
A regionally accredited US college or university.
A CHEA-member accredited non-US university where English is the official language of instruction.
A university in one of the listed countries, where English is the official language of instruction at that institution.
- OR -
Successful completion of at least 24 undergraduate credit hours (or 18 graduate credit
hours) with at least a 2.7 cumulative GPA on a 4.0 scale at a regionally accredited
US college or university.
Required Documentation
The English proficiency requirement will be updated on your application checklist
upon receipt and review of all applicable transcripts.
If your institution is not in the US, please also provide documentation regarding
the primary language of instruction.
For CHEA-member institutions, provide documentation confirming your institution's
membership.
Please note:
Graduate degrees that are strictly research-based with no academic coursework are
unacceptable for proof of English language proficiency.
Graduate Access Program Pathway
Successful completion of the Graduate Access Program (GAP) pathway through the University of Toledo's American Language Institute (ALI).
Required Documentation
You must provide a copy of your GAP acceptance letter to proceed with the review process.
Upon completion of the ALI program you must upload a copy of your ALI Completion Certificate.
